reason: I already stopped paying creators after getting likes and no customers, so I'm not going to start again just to try a counting tool. And I won't let some beta startup I've never heard of get between my staff, my bill book and my customers' phones.
objection: Who are you? A small new team could disappear in three months, and I don't want my counter staff doing PIN entry for a coupon system that might not be there next month.
would_change_my_mind: Another café or darshini owner nearby that I know telling me it actually showed which creator brought real people, and a creator offering to work with me only if they use it.
